threats.threat: Attacker modifies the SBOM to hide malicious components or misrepresent software composition.
threats.damageScenario: False software composition evidence submitted to a certification authority.
threats.attackVector: Unauthorized write access to sbom.json or sbom-spdx.json in the release directory.

threats.threat: Insider substitutes passing test results to conceal known defects.
threats.damageScenario: Defective software approved for use in a safety-critical system.
threats.attackVector: Modification of .fusaops-evidence.json before certification review by a developer with repository write access.
mitigations: CI-only write access to evidence artefacts

threats.asset: Language Adapter Tools (go-FuSa, c-FuSa, cpp-FuSa, etc.)
threats.threat: Supply-chain attacker replaces a language adapter binary with a trojaned version that suppresses findings.
threats.damageScenario: Safety defects not detected by the analysis pipeline; defective software ships.
threats.attackVector: Compromise of upstream tool registry, tampered container image, or PATH manipulation in CI.
mitigations: Hash verification in Software Configuration Index (fusaops sci)

threats.threat: Insider or attacker modifies the aggregate report to downgrade or remove findings.
threats.damageScenario: Safety defects concealed from engineering and certification review.
threats.attackVector: Direct file modification of report artefacts before or during review by a developer with local file access.

threats.threat: Attacker gains access to the HMAC signing key and creates fraudulent signed artefacts.
threats.damageScenario: Fraudulent signed artefacts accepted as legitimate evidence by a certification body.
threats.attackVector: Compromise of signing key stored in CI/CD secrets, developer workstation, or key management system.
mitigations: Hardware security modules for key storage

threats.threat: Attacker modifies or deletes requirement trace links to conceal coverage gaps.
threats.damageScenario: Incomplete requirements coverage not detected; defective design reaches production.
threats.attackVector: Unauthorized commit to the repository or direct modification of .fusaops-trace.json artefact.
mitigations: PR-gated branch protection with mandatory review

threats.threat: Attacker disrupts the CI/CD pipeline preventing safety analysis from running before release.
threats.damageScenario: Release proceeds without required safety analysis; unreviewed defects ship.
threats.attackVector: DoS against CI infrastructure, sabotage of build scripts, or removal of adapter tool binaries.
mitigations: Required status checks for all pull requests

threats.threat: Attacker modifies configuration to exclude safety-critical components from analysis.
threats.damageScenario: Known-dangerous code paths excluded from safety analysis; findings suppressed globally.
threats.attackVector: Unauthorized commit modifying .fusaops.json to add scan exclusions or disable adapters.
mitigations: PR review gate with code-owner approval

summary.assetInventoryMethod: count of FuSaOps' own sci package's knownArtefacts evidence-artefact inventory (10 items, DOC-001..DOC-010); non-file assets (adapter tool binaries, the CI/CD pipeline itself, .fusaops.json config) are analyzed as threat scenarios here but excluded from this file-based denominator
